def hidden_rule_fn(state):
    n = len(state)
    if n < 2:
        return state + [0]
    # Get last two elements
    a = state[-2]
    b = state[-1]
    xor_val = (a ^ b) % 7
    if n <= 3:
        new_val = xor_val
    elif n % 2 == 0:  # even length >= 4
        new_val = (a + b + 3) % 7
    else:  # odd length >= 4
        new_val = xor_val
    return state + [new_val]
